purpose: Tagger tags assigned to the cards/illustrations of fixtures/scryfall/meld.json, plus the full parent chain of each tag.
selector: oracle_tags: taggings[].oracle_id ∈ fixture oracle ids; art_tags: taggings[].illustration_id ∈ fixture illustration ids. Per target, tags sorted by (tagging has annotation / non-median weight first, tag has parents first, slug) and capped at 15 oracle / 10 art tags. Ancestors = transitive closure over parent_ids. taggings[] filtered to the fixture targets. Available per target: b23587e0…: 7 oracle tags; bce7e45d…: 7 oracle tags; f3e23d5e…: 4 oracle tags; 4c8cee4a…: 23 art tags; 9528e065…: 14 art tags; db5289ab…: 15 art tags.
note: Tag records are the original Tagger objects except: (1) taggings[] is FILTERED (see selector) and the fixture-added key `taggingsTotal` gives the unfiltered count; (2) child_ids[] is filtered to tags present in this file and the fixture-added key `childIdsTotal` gives the unfiltered count. parent_ids[] is complete: every ancestor is included, so the file is a closed sub-hierarchy in which child_ids is still the exact inverse of parent_ids. `taggingsTotal` and `childIdsTotal` are NOT source fields.

records.label: evasion
records.description: Creatures that are harder to block through keywords (flying, menace) or other means.

records.label: multiple species types
records.description: Creatures that have two or more types that are considered to be a species, such as "Human" or "Elf"

records.label: unique p/t
records.description: Cards with a power/toughness not seen on any other card.

records.label: unique type line
records.description: No other card has this same type line. Acorn, playtest, and rebalanced cards may count as unique, but they don't make non-acorn, non-playtest, non-rebalanced cards stop counting as unique.

records.label: cast trigger-self
records.description: Cards that have a trigger when they are cast

records.description: Return creature cards currently in the graveyard to the battlefield. Not to be confused with [cheat death](/tags/card/cheat-death), which interacts right as the creature dies.

records.label: typal coupling

records.label: alliteration
